## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] Tests added or updated for logic changes
- [ ] New source files carry the SPDX header
- [ ] Works fully offline (no account, server or sync)
- [ ] No personal data, keys or real endpoints in code, fixtures or screenshots
